Reranking with top_n parameter to limit results

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_rerank_async(client, "{\"documents\":[\"Python is a programming language.\",\"Cats are cute animals.\",\"Python was created by Guido van Rossum.\",\"The sun is a star.\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"What is Python?\",\"top_n\":2}")
IO.inspect(result.results)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).relevance_score)
```
